subject: Onsite demo coverage & recording — prospect travel conflict
messages:
From: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@travelscape.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Ellis <bob.ellis@travelscape.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week of Apr 25

Hi Mina,

Thanks for lining this up — the team is excited. Quick heads up: I just realized several folks (including our Head of Ops) will be on a previously-booked field trip Apr 26–28 and won't be available for a full onsite.

Would you be able to either:
- Move the onsite to the week of May 2 (preferred), or
- Run a condensed onsite on Apr 25 with a recording for the absent stakeholders?

If you can send a short agenda and any pre-read, I can circulate internally.

Appreciate it,
Claire
Claire Dunn
Director, Partnerships — Travelscape
claire.dunn@travelscape.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@travelscape.com>
Date: 2027-04-15T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week of Apr 25

Claire — thanks for the heads up. Totally understand. Attaching a tentative agenda (demo_agenda_v2.pdf) and a 30/60/90 cadence so you can see what we planned.

Two quick options:
1) Move to week of May 2 — we have SE availability Tue 5/4 and Thu 5/6.
2) Keep Apr 25 morning as a condensed 60-minute walkthrough focused on integration + cost/latency, we’ll record and share a timed index so absent stakeholders can jump to sections.

If you prefer, we can also do a hybrid: core team onsite on Apr 25 and a live virtual Q&A on 5/6 for the traveling group.

Which would you prefer? I can coordinate internal coverage either way.

— Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T08:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onsite demo week of Apr 25 — needs coverage/recording

Folks — FYI, Travelscape has travel the following week (26–28) and are asking to either push to May or do a condensed onsite with recording. My preference is to keep momentum and offer the hybrid (condensed onsite + recorded indexed session + live follow-up for traveling stakeholders).

Can Marcus cover the technical walkthrough Apr 25 morning if I keep Claire’s group onsite? Marcus — do you have a spare hour and can you record? Monica — can you draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can share that lists decision owners and next steps (I started a doc: mutual_action_plan.docx)?

Constraints:
- Marcus is on rotation with two other demos that week — if unavailable, we should propose 5/4 or 5/6 instead.
- Client wants the recording time-stamped (so they can skip to sections).

Thoughts?

— Mina
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Onsite demo week of Apr 25 — needs coverage/recording

Hi team — I can cover Apr 25 09:30–10:45 PT for a condensed technical walkthrough and will record the session. Plan: 15m intro (value props + success metrics), 30m live demo (integration + perf), 15m Q&A. I’ll include timestamps in the video description and export a short clip for the integration section.

If we need a live virtual Q&A for the traveling group the week of May 2, I’m available Thu 5/6 11:00–11:30 PT.

Monica — if you can put the MAP into a one-pager with names, deliverables, and dates I’ll use that during the call.

I’ll also open a calendar invite and attach a recording stub (demo_recording_stub.mp4) as a placeholder.

— Marcus
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Claire Dunn <claire.dunn@travelscape.com>, Bob Ellis <bob.ellis@travelscape.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite demo week of Apr 25 — confirmed plan

Claire/Bob — thanks for confirming travel. Per our internal sync: Marcus will run a condensed onsite walkthrough on Apr 25, 09:30–10:45 PT. We’ll record the session, add timestamps for each section, and share the recording within 24 hours. Monica has drafted a one-page MAP and I attached it here (mutual_action_plan.docx).

If the traveling stakeholders want a live Q&A, we propose Thu May 6, 11:00–11:30 PT (virtual). Please reply with the option you prefer (recording + May 6 Q&A, or full reschedule to week of May 2). Once you confirm I’ll send calendar invites and a final agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to the session.

— Mina
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx
